senses: to be or become low, sink, be humbled, be abased
to lay or bring low, humiliate
to set in a lower place, show abasement

strongs.def: to depress or sink (expectation figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive)
strongs.kjv: abase, bring (cast, put) down, debase, humble (self), be (bring, lay, make, put) low(-er)
